conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Fail checks involving sight. Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Can’t harm/attack charmer. Charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Disadvantage to checks/attacks while the source of fear is in sight. Can’t willingly move closer to the source of fear.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Speed 0, regardless of bonus. Ends when grappler is incapacitated or when moved out of grappler’s reach by an effect.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Can’t be seen (normally), but still make noise and tracks. Attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks within 5 ft are critical hits.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Unaware of surroundings. Resistance to all damage. Immune to poison / disease. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Stop aging. Weight increases by factor 10.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Crawl (at ½ speed) or stand up (costs ½ speed). Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage within 5 ft and disadvantage if further away.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed 0, regardless of bonus. Disadvantage on Dex saving throws. Attacks have disadvantage. Enemy attacks have advantage.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move. Can speak only falteringly. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated. Can’t move or speak. Unaware of surroundings. Drop everything. Fail Str and Dex saving throws. Enemy attacks have advantage. Enemy attacks within 5 ft are critical hits.
